description: NaFePH₂(CO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.49 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CPHCO tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent PCO₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.31 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one C and two O atoms. The C-C bond length is 1.52 Å. There is one shorter (1.27 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded to one C, one P, one H, and one O atom to form distorted CPHCO tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 70°. The C-P bond length is 1.87 Å. The C-H bond length is 1.10 Å. The C-O bond length is 1.44 Å. P is bonded to one C and three O atoms to form distorted PCO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.55 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.65 Å) H-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Fe, one C, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, one C, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one C atom.
